mentions.name: AI-generated text review UI
mentions.description: This review UI for AI-generated text lets users comment on specific words and make inline edits; Claude picks up both and revises the text in place, working like a PR review interface for text. Claude watches the files for new comments, edits them, and comments back right away.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have started to work on a little review UI for AI generated text, comments on specific words, inline edits, Claude picks up both and revises in place. Like a PR review interface for text.
mentions.author: arvida
